balls.text: lifter, whizzes off the pitch. Sarfraz is beaten on the hook and is socked on the helmet, the ball loops back to Morris. No return catch. Straight off the helmet
Sarfraz makes room outside leg, the bowler follows him. Spliced pull to long-on
jabbed to point for one
holes out to long-off. Back of a length and outside off, skewed to Rahane for a simple catch. The bottom hand came off the bat, foiling DK's timing
near yorker, pushed down to long-on
first ball six for DK! This was a low full toss, DK flips his wrists and puts it away over the backward square leg boundary for another of those flat sixes

Mandeep gets to a fifty of his own and pumps his first. Faulkner does not get hold of the yorker, pushes it full and outside off, Mandeep employs finesse and guides it between Sanju and short third man. Kohli sticks his tongue out and looks pumped. DK pats Mandeep on the helmet
fuller and on middle and leg, he stays deep in the crease and slugs it over midwicket for a flat six

very full on middle, not quite a yorker, drilled down to long-on. Stuart Binny swoops down on the ball and lets rip a flat throw to Faulkner. The pair hare across for the second. AB dives but is caught short, Faulkner takes it on the half-volley and whipped the bails off. AB knew he was out, he started walking as soon as the stumps were disturbed. The batsmen cross over
mighty full on middle, AB backs away and drives it to long-off
Faulkner aims for a yorker, goes too full on the stumps, drilled down to long-on. They scamper across for a couple
short, slowy ball on off. Short-arm pulled to long-on
length ball on off, AB loads up and flat-bats it to long-on. Kohli stands up and applauds
smokin' hit! Juicy length ball outside off, AB stays in the crease and annihilates a six over deep midwicket. Away she sails over the boundary
top-edge, six and fifty for AB. Banged in short, well-directed by Morris. AB pulls manages a top-edge that soars over fine leg
near yorker at the base of off, shovelled down to long-on for one
on the hips, slog-swept away behind square on the leg side. Mandeep wants two, rushes back for it. Puts in a dive and beats the throw
on a length and outside off, Mandeep swings wildly and does not connect
on a fullish length and outside off, Mandeep gets low and mishits it, dragging it to mid-on
low full-toss outside off, slapped to the left of mid-off. Diving save from Smith
on a good length and on middle and leg, AB looks to maul it over the leg side. He gets a thick leading edge that balloons over the covers. Lands in front of sweeper cover
very full and outside off, Sanju can't collect it cleanly
edged and eludes Samson. Watson is not pleased. Back of a length and outside off, AB slashes hard and gets a thick outer edge that flies over a leaping Samson
Watson fires in a yorker at the base of off, jammed back at the bowler
full marks for timing and placement! Pitched up full and outside off, he bends his knee and drills it between mid-off and the covers
length on off, Mandeep loads up and plays a flat-batted push back to Faulkner
short and wide outside off, Mandeep steps away outside leg and ramps it over the man at short third man
Faulkner has his hands on his head. Might have been a slower ball. Mandeep is early into the slog and misses it. The ball misses the leg stump by a whisker
top, top strike. Mandeep flits down the track, makes room outside leg, creating enough leverage to smash it over extra cover
fuller and on middle and leg, whipped away towards deep midwicket
back of a length and on middle and leg, clipped to long-on. Rahane is quickly onto the ball. Mandeep dives and makes his ground
pushed through on a back of a length, punched down to long-on
that's a rocket from AB! Darted full and wide outside off, AB bends his knees and sends it screaming away past the covers. He has rediscovered his range..
another slog-sweep and another six! Flatter and on middle and leg, slog-swept high into the air. Rahane runs across to his right from deep midwicket, leaps but the ball goes over him
length on off, knocked towards cover-point for one
hurled full and outside off, drilled to long-off
clears midwicket. Pushed through full on middle and leg, AB sinks to one knee and thumps a six over deep midwicket with a powerful slog-sweep
back of a length and on off, AB wants to thunk it through the covers, but has to settle with an inside edge onto the pad, which rebounds towards the covers
AB walks across off and puts the bowler off. Watson fires a low full toss, which dips outside off. Past the tram-line
good length and curves away with some extra bounce outside off. He swishes and only connects with thin air
fuller and on middle and leg, tucked away in front of square leg
short, bumpy ball, swerves away outside off. Mandeep reaches out but can't slice it away. Wide called
back of a length and well outside off, AB himself shuffled miles across off, missing the lap-sweep. Off the pad and runs away to the off side
pitched up and outside off, driven towards mid-off. Smith dives across to his left and makes a good save
length ball on off, dabbed to point

AB steps down the track and drills it back at Ankit, who sticks his left hand out and intercepts the ball. The go to the TV umpire for a return catch. Strange, since Ankit did not claim the catch. Replays show that it had bounced in front of him. Bump ball.
darted flat and wide outside off, AB lets it pass. Just inside the tram-line
slid through on off, pushed back to the bowler, who dives to his left and stops the ball
pushed through quicker and outside off, tapped to sweeper cover
fuller and outside off, Mandeep takes it from a fifth-stump line and lap-sweeps it to the left of Faulkner at short third man
very full and wide outside off, he bends his knee and slaps it past the covers. Sweeper hunts it down
banged in short and rises on middle, Mandeep rocks back and pulls it over midwicket. Beats the man in the deep, leaving Kohli standing up and applauding from the dug out
fuller and on middle and leg, he comes down the track and flicks it to midwicket
change of pace around off, dinked finer of short third man
on a length and outside off, dabbed down to third man for one
drifting onto the pads, he does not meet with the flick. Sanju flings to his left to collect the ball. They sneak a leg-bye
welcome back, Faulkner says Mandeep. Shortish and outside off, Mandeep gets on top of the bounce, carving it up and over backward point, one-bounce four
very full and on middle and off, AB is cramped for room, pushing it back to the bowler
Mandeep waits on this back-of-a-length ball outside off and glides it to deep third man
length on the stumps, down the track and pushed to mid-on
on a length and shaping away outside off, dabbed past first slip with soft hands
back of a length and outside off, guided to deep point
sublime timing here. No complaints. On a fuller length and outside off, Mandeep gets under it, bends his knees and sends it clattering over long-off. Clean strike.. That spoils Kulkarni's figures
fractionally short, Mandeep plays a front-foot pull through midwicket. He did not time it properly but still gets a boundary
on a length and outside off, he camps back and plays it to point with an open face
length on off, steered down to third man for one. Slowest fifty for RCB this season
pitched up and outside off, down the track and flashily driven to mid-off. Mandeep hares across for the single. Smith collects the ball quickly and puts in a poor throw at the keepers'
shortish and just a shade outside off, AB hops up and works a single to mid-on
Mandeep nearly nicked this off! Fuller and swerves away outside off, Mandeep pokes and watches the ball skim past the outer edge
back of a length and outside off, moves away further. Mandeep slashes and gets beaten
similar length and outside off, AB camps back and dinks it to deep third man
back of a length and close to off, AB does not have enough room. Plays a jabbing punch to the covers
length and outside off, AB ventures down the track. Swats and can't connect
on a length and outside off at 129ks, AB waits on it before dabbing it to the right of Sanju
on a length and comes in on middle, worked to the right of short midwicket
similar length and outside off, Mandeep aims to force it through the covers. Mishits it to the fielder
back of a length and outside off, left alone

Two big wickets in four balls for Dhawal on day he was picked for Bangladesh tour. Kohli's attempted encore fails! This was on a length and just outside off, Kohli aims to turn it to midwicket, closes his bat face and chips it back to the bowler. Dhawal moves to his left and snaffles it
impressive running between the wickets.. Back of a length and on off, Kohli twirls his wrists and manipulates it through midwicket
Kohli flits down the track, looks to go over the covers and misses. Dhawal pulls his length back outside off. Loads of bounce and zipping through outside off
Kohli seeks to step out, Ankit pushes a low full toss outside off, which is jabbed to the left of the covers for one
pitched up and outside off, driven calmly to sweeper cover. AB gets off the mark
fullish and on middle and leg, milked through midwicket for one
fired wide outside off, Kohli reaches out and flashes it to point
slid through quicker outside leg, Kohli misses the glance and takes it on the pad
looped up on off, patted into the covers
Kulkarni rattles the top of middle. Gayle races down the track and hunts for a big swipe. Dhawal marginally shortens his length. Gayle misses, Dhawal hits and exults. End of Gayle. End of Powerplay.
on a length and outside off, steered to the right of deep third man
pitched up and on off, Kohli presses forward and pushes it back to the bowler
back of a length and on off, Kohli solidly blocks it to the covers
back of a length and hurries onto Gayle, who mishits it. Dragging it in front of long-on
good length and outside off, glided to third man
on a length and outside off, right in the hitting zone of Gayle. He loads up for a lusty club over midwicket but only connects with thin air
full and straight, clipped to midwicket
ripper of a yorker! Gayle squeezes out four. Inswinging yorker, Gayle jabs his bat down, squirts it through his legs, fine on the leg side. Short fine leg had no chance
pitched up and teasing Gayle outside off. He swishes his bat out of the way
Morris strays down leg, wide called
dragged short and outside off, he fetches it from there and whacks a pull over midwicket, beats mid-on to his left
back of a length and outside off, steered down to third man
length on middle and leg, tucking up Gayle for room. Some inward movement here as well. Pushed quietly back to the bowler
veering down leg, Gayle can't meet with the flick. Wide called
full and wide outside off, Kohli reaches out and slashes it to deep third man
picked away off the pads behind square on the leg side
full and attacking the stumps, blocked back to the bowler
back of a length, pushed to mid-on for a speedy one
this does not bounce at all! Full and curves away outside off, Kohli wafts and gets beaten
excellent riposte from Kulkarni. Bangs a bouncer, loads of height on it. Gayle is beaten on the pull. Sanju is beaten as well, the ball leaps over him
looks like a slower length ball, Gayle goes on the back foot, winds up and wallops a six over long-on. It actually skewed off the toe-end of the bat. But still went all the way
length on off, pushed back to the bowler
Gayle nips down the track, the bowler pulls his length back. He swings and does not connect. Nice TV-friendly carry to the keeper
similar length on middle and leg, Gayle hacks and drags it to mid-on off the inner part of the bat
back of a length and outside off, Gayle ventures deep in the crease and slaps it fiercely to the right of mid-off
on a length and outside off, punchy drive past the covers

a direct hit could have consumed Gayle! Back of a length and on middle, tucks up Gayle for room. Glanced behind square on the leg side. There is a communication breakdown. Gayle wants two and is halfway down the pitch. Kohli is least interested and sends Gayle back. The fielder (Binny) runs across, collects the ball and throws it to Sanju. He aims for a direct hit at the non-strikers' but misses. Gayle escapes. Faulkner should have made an effort to rush to the other end instead of standing on the middle of the pitch
good length and on off, Gayle camps back and defends it in front of point
fullish and angling away, Kohli now secures a single to third man, past first slip. Dabbed with soft hands
on a length and outside off, Gayle has a crack at it, getting a thick outside edge that flies past the lone slip fielder
back of a length and outside off, flat-batted to mid-off. Smith runs across and keeps it to a dot
Gayle waits on this slower ball outside off and dinks it to deep third man with an open face
fraction short and outside off, Gayle swat-pulls it back to the bowler. Not well-timed again
on a length and outside off, Gayle throws his bat at it, flat-batting it ram-rod straight, so much so it hits the stumps at the non-strikers'. Nor much power behind that
fuller, tight line, close to off now, Gayle opts for caution and shoulders arms
crunchh! Width on offer outside off, Gayle hits through the line. Flaying a drive past the covers, beats mid-off to his right
swing straightaway! Full and swinging in on the pads, flicked to short midwicket, where Karun Nair makes a sharp diving save

bowled'im. RCB advance to Qualifier 2. They set up CSK Ranchi date for a place in the final. Chahal slips in the googly, Kulkarni fails to pick it after making room, he drives and doesn't connect. Chahal hits middle and off.
short and wide outside off, he goes on the back foot and slaps it to the covers
length on off, he sinks to one knee and slog-sweeps it high in the air. Just dies in front of Mandeep at deep midwicket
googly, spins in on off. Defensively pushed to the covers
pitched up and outside off, he throws his bat at it and slices it over the covers
floated up on middle and leg, pushed to long-on
length and angling away outside off, he pokes limply and gets beaten
pitched up and on off, driven past the covers for one
short and dragged down leg, wide called
short and wide outside off, Kulkarni can't slice it away
good length on off, pressed to the covers
lowish full toss outside off, he pushes and misses. The ball was not far away from the off stump
pitched up and angled in on off, Kulkarni covers his stumps and shuts it down to the off side
back of a length and outside off, he steps away and flashes it past the covers. Starc gets across from sweeper cover, fumbles and gives away a four. RR reach three figures
another nail rammed in the RR coffin. Wiese bangs it short and outside off, Hooda is in no position to pull, mis-times it, hit high on the bat for a simple catch at deep square leg
length on middle, pressed into the covers for a quick one. He dives and makes his ground
slower one on off, flat-batted to long-on
short and wide outside off, stabbed to backward point
Hooda steps out, manufactures a low full toss and slices it in the air. AB sprints in from sweeper, but the ball lands in front of him
Morris bags a duck, picks out Chahal at mid-off. Full and on middle, Morris backs away and slices it straight down the throat of Chahal
Morris steps out, makes room. Swings and misses a shortish ball
pitched up and on off, chipped in the air in front of long-on
back of a length and on off, defended
back of a length and outside off, he kitchen-sinks it over the covers
on a length and outside off, pushed to backward point with an open face
push and a miss to a length ball angling away outside off

Binny gone for a golden duck. This was on a back of a length, he skips out and misses the flick, the ball dribbles towards backward point. Binny rushes off in pursuit of a quick single. But is sent back. Its all too late and he is caught short. Good work from Chahal

Aravind claims a catch, appeals. He is celebrating.. They go to the TV umpire. Legal ball. This was a low full toss, dips in on off. Faulkner shuffles across, aims to slog, gets an inside edge onto the front boot and lobs it back to Aravind. Smart return catch after stretching to his left. RR slide to 92 for 6
back of a length and sliding away outside off. Faulkner has a crude swipe at it, does not connect
shortish and on the leg stump, he swivels on the back foot and pulls it backward of square leg
bumper from Aravind, Faulkner looked interested in a pull before pulling his head out of the way in a jerky motion. Wide called for height
banged in short on off, fends it to the right of DK
Rahane gone now, he perishes to scoreboard pressure. RR continue to fade away. Flat around off, Rahane sinks to one knee, goes for a slog sweep and top-edges it to AB at deep midwicket
sees Rahane come down the track, drags his length back. Punched down the ground past the bowler
fuller on middle and leg, clipped to the right of the bowler. Chahal dives and intercepts the ball
flicked off the pads to deep square leg
flatter and quicker outside off, cracked to point, who dives across to his right and stops the ball
loopy legbreak, grips in the surface and turns away. Diffused i front of the covers
another of those slower balls, which is nudged away in front of square on the leg side
hoodwinked by the change-up. Offcutter outside off, Hooda pokes and misses
bouncer, sails over to DK, after beating the batsman on the hook
fuller and outside off, chipped in the air to the left of mid-on. Kohli beetles in pursuit and hauls the ball in before relaying it to Wiese (I think)
back of a length and outside off, Hooda shoulders arms

caught behind! Simple catch for DK. On a length and zipping through outside off with some extra pace. Karun perhaps looked for the cut with his feet paralysed to the crease, only feeds an outside edge to the keeper, who throws the ball up in the air and celebrates
pitched up and on off, milked through mid-on. The call is for two and RR get it
back of a length and outside off, Karun hunts for a cut and chops it towards cover-point
good length on off, defended tentatively
back of a length, defended back to the bowler off the inner part of the bat
dabbed in front of point for on
thick edge flies to the right of DK. Difficult catch. On a length and outside off, Rahane slogs hard and gets a thick outer edge. DK could just glove it away
superb effort from AB (who else?). Back of a length and outside off, cut away past backward point. AB runs across to his left from sweeper cover, slides and keeps it to two
back of a length and on middle and leg, Karun camps back and pushes it back to the bowler
dug in short and outside off, flat-batted past Aravind to long-on
lifter climbs on the leg stump, Rahane pulls and does not connect
dropped shortish and outside off, flat-batted back to Aravind without much timing
back of a length and on middle and off, Rahane is cramped for room. Defensively pushed back to the bowler.
full and on middle and leg, worked to midwicket
fired outside off, Karn Nair chases and gets a thick outer edge just past the gloves of DK. Too harsh to call that a drop. Harshal slides in the deep in vain
back of a length and on the hips, whippy-punch to long-on
slower through the air on off, laced inside out to long-off
pitched up and outside off, Chahal held this one back. Looks like a googly. Chipped in front of a diving Wiese
straight roller on middle, glanced to short fine leg for one
fuller and outside off, knocked towards backward point with an open face
one-bounce four! Karn nails this. Short and outside off, sits up to he hit. Pumps it over midwicket with a strong pull
back of a length and zipping through outside off, Karun is beaten first ball, prodding and missing
length on off, steered to the left of backward point
fuller and outside off, dabbed to backward point
drifts this slower ball down leg, wide called

AB takes it at sweeper cover! Smith has to depart. Pitched up, outside off and cuts away, Smith nips down the track, but does not connect well with the lofted strike. Slices it into the hands of AB for a dolly. He reverse-cups his hands around it
short and on off, he shifts his balance onto the back foot and pulls it to deep midwicket
tossed up legbreak outside off, Smith steps down the track and nudges it through midwicket. He seeks two and gets it
pushed through quicker, skiddy ball. Short-arm pulled to the leg side
dug in short on off, he rocks back and mis-times a pull to long-on
slid through outside off, punched to backward point, diving stop from Mandeep
flighted and on off, down the track. Smith does not meet the pitch of the ball and takes it on the pad
edged and out of reach of DK, who was diving to his right. Fullish and nibbles away off the deck outside off, Rahane has a loose push at it, gets an outer edge that runs away fine on the off side
back of a length and on off, punched down to long-on
short and hurries onto Rahane, who goes for a pull, hit high on the bat. Gets it over midwicket
on a length and outside off, stabbed to sweeper cover
fuller and on middle and leg, worked to the right of short midwicket

Rahane wants two and they go to the TV umpire. Rahane slides his bat and grounds it. This was banged in short and just outside off, pulled over midwicket. Starc gets across from deep square leg and flings a bullet throw. Rahane is in, though
pitched up and outside off, Smith lays into another cover-drive. This time he finds the fielder
b-e-a-u-t-i-f-u-l. Full and outside off, Smith shuffles across off and caresses a lofted-drive over the covers
back of a length and outside off, Smith shuffles across, gets on top of the bounce and punches it to the covers
full and seams in on off, Rahane has a waft at it, gets an inner edge that sneaks away fine on the leg side
back of a length and on off, too close to cut. He ends up chopping it to the covers
full and wide outside off, Smith aims to drive and skews it to third man off a thick outside edge
short and wide outside off, slashed to deep third man on the bounce

Harshal Patel strikes! The short ball works. This was banged in and climbs alarmingly on the stumps, Samson perhaps was caught in two minds whether to play at it or sway his upper body out of the way. He can't get out of the tangle and ends up faint-edging it to DK
fuller and on off, Rahane gets a positive stride forward and laces it to mid-on for one
on a length and width on offer outside off, late-cut to third man
back of a length and on off, jabbing punch to mid-off after pressing forward
pitched up on off, slower ball at 116ks. Bunted to mid-on for one
picked away off the hips through vacant midwicket. By the time Starc runs in from the deep and collects the ball, they take two
much fuller on off, draws Sanju into a forward-defensive push to point
short again on off, swat-pulled to mid-on
dug in short on off, Rahane shifts his balance onto the back foot and pulls it away to the cow-corner boundary. Aravind does not have enough pace to pose a threat to Rahane
good length ball sliding away with the angle, guided to deep third man
width on offer outside off, flat-batted without much power towards mid-off
banged in short and climbs outside off, Rahane carves it away to deep third man
very, very wristy! Swerves in on the pads, Rahane flicks it beautifully past midwicket, skips away to the boundary
banged in short as Harshal sees Sanju skip down the track, worked quietly towards midwicket
pitched up and outside off, driven to backward point. Mandeep dives to his right and makes a sharp stop before getting up and thumping his chest
length ball on off, Rahahe uses his wrists and turns it to mid-on
pitched up and moves away outside off, keeps low and beats Rahane's feeble little push

Watson has nicked off! DK and Gayle go up straightaway.. The forefinger goes up slowly. This was on a good length and angling away outside off, Watson chases it and can only edge it to the keeper, who moves to his right and snaps it up. Kohli is pumped, super-pumped..
pitched up and outside off, Rahane gets forward and the result is a flowy drive to the left of mid-off. Wiese stops it, lands on his shoulder but no harm done
dug in on a back of a length and outside off, Watson arches his back and cuts it uppishly to the off-side sweeper
fuller and nibbles in on middle and leg, turned to mid-on for one
full and angling away wide outside off, Rahane is caught on a fishing expedition. Beaten
drifting onto the hips, Rahane does not get hold of the flick
good length and curling away with the angle, Rahane inches forward and has a lazy push at it. He manages an inside edge that wanders in front of square on the leg side
on a length and angling away outside off at 142.5ks, played defensively to point
Watson rides the bounce of this short ball and steers it to deep third man
and another! Starc stays on the hips, flicked crisply behind square on the leg side for back-to-back fours. Long leg had no chance of cutting that off
back of a length and outside off, Watson attacks it, leans back and slaps it in the gap at point
banged in short and rises outside off, loads of bounce on it. Rahane employs soft hands and dabs it towards short third man
